notes: 2026 orientation was May 9 and training May 16.
name: ZooTeens
what_you_do: Summer teen volunteers greet guests as Junior Ambassadors. Or they talk about animals as Junior Docents. Or they work in the Safari Gift Shop.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 15 to 18. Must be 15 by the volunteer orientation date (May 9 in 2026). Orientation and training are required.
duration: Late May to early August, at least 30 hours, shifts of 2 to 4 hours
deadline_text: 2026 interview spots were filled. Page says check back in February 2027 for next summer.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page in February 2027 for the form and interviews.
